origin: it should NOT report lazzy logging
source:
defmodule CredoSampleModule do
  def some_function(parameter1, parameter2) do
    Logger.debug fn ->
      "A debug message: #{inspect(1)}"
    end
  end
end

origin: it should NOT report imported :debug from Logger
source:
defmodule CredoSampleModule do
  import Logger, only: debug

  def some_function(parameter1, parameter2) do
    debug fn ->
      "Some message: #\{CredoSampleModule\}"
    end
  end
end

origin: it should NOT report for user-defined debug function
source:
defmodule CredoSampleModule do
  import Enum

  def debug(whatever) do
    whatever
  end

  def some_function(parameter1, parameter2) do
    debug "Inspected: #\{CredoSampleModule\}"
  end
end
